reviews.title: Proven by Reviews, Not Ads
reviews.description: HiFive English has grown through reviews from parents and students who've experienced our lessons firsthand, instead of ad spending.

r1.author: Kim O-eun's Parent
r1.content: At first my child was very shy on video, but the teacher always greeted her warmly, so now class time is what she looks forward to most. The learning evaluation report shows exactly which expressions she struggled with each time, which has made reviewing at home much easier.

r2.author: Park O-jun
r2.content: I used to only study English for school tests, but after starting video English, I can now speak my thoughts in English right away with a native teacher. She corrects my grammar mistakes on the spot, so I can really feel myself improving.

r3.author: Lee O-young's Parent
r3.content: I compared several video English services, and this one had the most thorough teacher matching and management. Every time I consult with them, they clearly understand my child's situation, which builds real trust. Being able to see my child's progress visually through the monthly level test is also a huge plus.

r4.author: Choi O-ah
r4.content: I travel for business often, so I needed business English. My teacher taught me expressions tailored to my actual work situations, and I use them all the time now. Scheduling is flexible and the teacher is great — I'm very satisfied.

r5.author: Jung O-ho's Parent
r5.content: Instead of a generic "great job," they give specific feedback on what my child learned and struggled with each day. The consistent care makes it easy to understand why this place grew by word of mouth alone, without advertising.

r6.author: Han O-su
r6.content: At first, speaking English every day felt like a burden, but thanks to the repeated practice, I can now form sentences much faster. Sometimes my teacher's schedule fills up, which is a bit disappointing, but overall I'm very satisfied.

sarah.intro: An elementary specialist who uses bright energy to help kids open up and start speaking.
sarah.detail: With over 10 years of experience teaching English to children, Sarah guides kids to build sentences on their own through step-by-step repeated practice, from phonics to reading. Her praise-and-encouragement teaching style is especially well suited for children starting video English for the first time.

james.intro: A secondary-school specialist who rapidly improves students' skills with logical, structured feedback.
james.detail: James teaches grammar correction, essay writing, and debate to secondary school and adult learners. Going beyond simple conversation, he provides precise, sentence-level feedback that strengthens both exam English and practical English at the same time.

emily.intro: A teacher who builds confidence with expressions you can use immediately in everyday life and at work.
emily.detail: Emily builds a customized curriculum around each adult learner's goals — travel, business, or everyday conversation. She emphasizes the courage to "just try speaking" over perfect sentences, correcting mistakes on the spot during class.
career: Graduate of University of Brighton, UK
Top Satisfaction Ratings from Adult Learners

daniel.intro: A teacher who builds the ability to think in English in a relaxed, comfortable atmosphere.
daniel.detail: Daniel excels at putting learners at ease with a cheerful, friendly teaching style. Through repeated Q&A practice that builds sentences on the spot, he sharpens students' quick thinking for real conversation situations.
career: 7 Years Teaching Video English to All Ages

aboutTeaser.quote: "We grow through the results of our teaching and our customers' trust — not advertising."
aboutTeaser.quote_sub: This is the most important principle HiFive English has upheld for 12 years.
aboutTeaser.company_tagline: HiFive English · 12 Years in Video English Education
aboutTeaser.heading: English Education Optimized for EFL Learners — That Actually Works
aboutTeaser.paragraph1: Simply listening and reading a lot isn't enough to become fluent in English. Through interactive video English lessons with native and expert foreign teachers, HiFive English runs a program where learners immediately apply what they learn during class, naturally improving their listening and speaking skills in the process.
aboutTeaser.paragraph2: Rather than simply finishing a set textbook on schedule, we place the highest priority on building English learners can actually use — through repeated practice, Q&A, free conversation, sentence correction, and diverse feedback tailored to each learner's level and goals.
